learning_outcomes.statement: The learner can index, slice, and iterate strings; use in/not in and bounded truthiness correctly; and explain why strings are immutable.
The learner can use string methods, formatting (f-strings), and input() together to build small validation/text-processing mini-projects (password/email check, word counter).
